metadata.description: Skills for security, monitoring, deployment operations, drawing, Plane, and design stress testing. English-only. Installable via npm CLI and plugin marketplaces.

plugins.name: security-sast
plugins.description: Whitebox/static security workflows for source code, config, dependencies, containers, IaC, threat modeling, scanner-output review, finding normalization, and hardening gates.

plugins.name: security-dast
plugins.description: Blackbox/dynamic security workflows for authorized runtime targets, active surface scans, API and web probing, TLS checks, fuzzing, pentest reports, finding normalization, and hardening gates.

plugins.name: monitoring
plugins.description: Monitoring workflows for read-only health checks, dashboard and alert design, telemetry coverage, dependency and runtime vulnerability inventory, and incident triage.

plugins.name: deployment-ops
plugins.description: Deployment workflows for release readiness, GCP MIG rollouts, Docker service ops, Ansible Runner, Semaphore UI/API, rollback, and verification.

plugins.name: drawing
plugins.description: Diagram creation router for Mermaid and Excalidraw, covering Markdown-native diagrams and visual .excalidraw artifacts.

plugins.name: plane
plugins.description: Plane.so project management workflow for looking up, listing, creating, and updating work items through the Plane REST API.

plugins.name: roast
plugins.description: Relentless one-question-at-a-time design interview and docs-aware plan stress testing triggered by "roast me".
